# Documentation

This doc tree is declared in `manifest.json`: five typed pages, one per
kind. `code2doc status` prints the freshness of every declared page and
checks ordinary links between pages for target existence.

- [Overview](overview.md) — static structure of the codebase
- [src module](modules/greet.md) — public interface of `src/`
- [Greeting flow](flows/greeting.md) — one execution path, walked
- [How to greet a user](howtos/greet-a-user.md) — distilled task guide
- [Symbol reference](reference/symbols.md) — tabular lookup
